How to run

It's a slightly modernized version of my instruction from #330708.

How to run

  1. Build VM Grab this definition of NixOS VM and replace myawesomehostname with the hostname of your host. (the VM and the host should have the same hostname)

    vm.nix 
    let
  hostname = "myawesomehostname"; # Replace with your hostname
in
{
  "${hostname}" =
    { config, pkgs, ... }:
    {
      services.nextcloud = {
        enable = true;
        hostName = hostname;
        config.adminpassFile = "/etc/nextcloud-admin-pass";
        config.dbtype = "sqlite";
        extraApps = {
          inherit (config.services.nextcloud.package.packages.apps) richdocuments;
        };
      };
      environment.etc."nextcloud-admin-pass".text = "a";

      services.collabora-online = {
        enable = true;
        settings = {
          ssl.enable = false;
          ssl.termination = false;
        };
        aliasGroups = [ { host = "http://${hostname}"; } ];
      };

      systemd.services.nextcloud-setup-collabora = {
        after = [ "nextcloud-setup.service" ];
        wantedBy = [ "multi-user.target" ];
        path = [ config.services.nextcloud.occ ];
        serviceConfig = {
          Type = "oneshot";
          User = "nextcloud";
          ExecStart = pkgs.writeScript "nextcloud-setup-collabora.sh" ''
            #!${pkgs.runtimeShell}
            nextcloud-occ config:app:set richdocuments disable_certificate_verification --value yes
            nextcloud-occ richdocuments:setup --wopi-url=http://${hostname}:9980
          '';
        };
      };

      networking.firewall.enable = false;
      virtualisation = {
        forwardPorts = [
          {
            from = "host";
            guest.port = 80;
            host.port = 80;
          }
          {
            from = "host";
            guest.port = 9980;
            host.port = 9980;
          }
        ];
      };

      system.stateVersion = "26.05";
    };
}

    Build it with the following command:

    NIXPKGS_PATH=/path/to/nixpkgs # Replace this with your path

NIX_PATH=nixpkgs=$NIXPKGS_PATH nix-shell "$NIXPKGS_PATH" -A nixos-build-vms --run 'nixos-build-vms ./vm.nix'

  2. Run VM

    sudo ./result/bin/nixos-run-vms

    Sudo is required to bind the VM to port 80.

  3. Login In a browser, go to http://myawesomehostname. It will prompt you with a login page. Enter root and a.

  4. Create a new document In the top left corner select "Files", then "+ New", then "New Document". Press "Create". Click on the newly created document to open it. The Collabora Online editor should appear.

  5. Verify version In the top menubar select "Help", then "About". In the appeared window:

    • "COOLWSD version" is related to nixpkgs.collabora-online aka the web service.
    • "LOKit version" is related to nixpkgs.libreoffice-collabora aka fork of LibreOffice that this web service uses.
